label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss) alert-TP: corr = request.getHeader('X-Correlation-Id') resolves to attacker-controllable HTTP header value. The header value flows directly to response.getWriter().println('id=' + corr) without HTML encoding. Custom headers like X-Correlation-Id can be injected by clients (curl, browser scripts, proxy attacks). Resolved sink value: corr = attacker-controlled header value. No mitigation between source and sink.
